words.definitionEn: a reason or case so strong that it is difficult to disagree with; useful when you present or praise a position in Writing Task 2 or Speaking Part 3
words.exampleEn: Supporters of online learning make a compelling argument about access for students in rural areas.
words.exampleUz: Onlayn ta'lim tarafdorlari qishloq o'quvchilarining imkoniyati haqida juda ishonarli dalil keltiradi.

words.definitionEn: to show clearly that two things are different; a formal way to keep an argument precise
words.exampleEn: We should draw a distinction between memorising vocabulary and actually using it.
words.exampleUz: So'zlarni yodlash bilan ularni amalda ishlatish o'rtasidagi farqni aniq ko'rsatishimiz kerak.

words.definitionEn: worry felt by a large number of people across society
words.exampleEn: There is widespread concern about the amount of time teenagers spend on social media.
words.exampleUz: O'smirlarning ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda o'tkazayotgan vaqti bo'yicha keng tarqalgan xavotir bor.

words.definitionEn: to be a possible source of danger or harm; more formal than 'be dangerous'
words.exampleEn: Rising sea levels pose a serious threat to coastal cities.
words.exampleUz: Dengiz sathining ko'tarilishi qirg'oq shaharlariga jiddiy xavf tug'dirmoqda.

words.definitionEn: results that affect many areas of life and last a long time
words.exampleEn: The decision to close village schools had far-reaching consequences for local families.
words.exampleUz: Qishloq maktablarini yopish qarori mahalliy oilalar uchun keng qamrovli oqibatlarga olib keldi.

words.definitionEn: a personal or financial reason for wanting a situation to continue; often used when questioning someone's motives
words.exampleEn: Oil companies have a vested interest in delaying the shift to clean energy.
words.exampleUz: Neft kompaniyalari toza energiyaga o'tishni kechiktirishdan shaxsan manfaatdor.

words.definitionEn: to make more people understand that a problem exists
words.exampleEn: Campaigns in schools can raise awareness of the dangers of plastic waste.
words.exampleUz: Maktablardagi tashviqot plastik chiqindi xavfi haqidagi xabardorlikni oshirishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: a reasonable idea that deserves to be taken seriously; ideal for conceding before you disagree
words.exampleEn: Critics of remote work make a valid point about the loss of teamwork.
words.exampleUz: Masofaviy ishga qarshi chiqqanlar jamoaviy ishning yo'qolishi haqida o'rinli fikr aytishadi.

words.definitionEn: to supply enough of something for everyone who wants it
words.exampleEn: Universities are struggling to meet demand for places in IT programmes.
words.exampleUz: Universitetlar IT yo'nalishlaridagi o'rinlarga bo'lgan talabni qondirishga qiynalmoqda.

words.definitionEn: a habit or pattern that is becoming more common over time
words.exampleEn: There is a growing tendency among young people to work as freelancers.
words.exampleUz: Yoshlar orasida frilanser bo'lib ishlash tendensiyasi kuchayib bormoqda.

words.definitionEn: to be extremely important in producing a result
words.exampleEn: Parents play a crucial role in shaping a child's attitude to reading.
words.exampleUz: Ota-onalar bolaning kitobga munosabatini shakllantirishda hal qiluvchi rol o'ynaydi.

words.definitionEn: a wrong idea that many people believe; a strong way to open a counter-argument
words.exampleEn: It is a common misconception that children learn languages effortlessly.
words.exampleUz: Bolalar tilni osongina o'rganadi degan fikr keng tarqalgan noto'g'ri tasavvur.

words.definitionEn: to reduce the difference between two groups, levels or situations
words.exampleEn: Free online courses help bridge the gap between city and village education.
words.exampleUz: Bepul onlayn kurslar shahar va qishloq ta'limi o'rtasidagi tafovutni kamaytiradi.

words.definitionEn: another option that could realistically work
words.exampleEn: For short journeys, cycling is a viable alternative to driving.
words.exampleUz: Qisqa masofalar uchun velosiped mashinaga real muqobil bo'la oladi.

words.definitionEn: to affect someone or something for a long period afterwards
words.exampleEn: A single inspiring teacher can have a lasting impact on a student's career.
words.exampleUz: Bitta ilhomlantiruvchi o'qituvchi talabaning karyerasiga uzoq muddatli ta'sir qoldirishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: existing for a long time and very hard to change, especially about beliefs or habits
words.exampleEn: Attitudes towards gender roles are deeply rooted in tradition.
words.exampleUz: Gender rollariga bo'lgan qarashlar an'analarda chuqur ildiz otgan.

words.definitionEn: to come to understand something complex more clearly
words.exampleEn: Internships allow students to gain an insight into how companies really work.
words.exampleUz: Amaliyot talabalarga kompaniyalar aslida qanday ishlashi haqida chuqur tushuncha beradi.

words.definitionEn: a large enough part of a group to matter; useful for describing data or trends
words.exampleEn: A significant proportion of graduates never work in the field they studied.
words.exampleUz: Bitiruvchilarning salmoqli qismi o'zi o'qigan sohada umuman ishlamaydi.

words.definitionEn: to find a sensible middle position between two competing needs
words.exampleEn: Governments must strike a balance between economic growth and protecting nature.
words.exampleUz: Hukumatlar iqtisodiy o'sish bilan tabiatni muhofaza qilish o'rtasida muvozanat topishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: a change for the better that is clearly noticeable
words.exampleEn: After six months of practice there was a marked improvement in her speaking.
words.exampleUz: Olti oylik mashqdan so'ng uning gapirish ko'nikmasida sezilarli yaxshilanish bo'ldi.

words.definitionEn: to start dealing with a problem seriously; the standard formal verb for 'solve' in essays
words.exampleEn: The city has finally begun to address the issue of air pollution.
words.exampleUz: Shahar nihoyat havo ifloslanishi muammosini hal qilishga kirishdi.

words.definitionEn: the real reason behind a problem, which is not immediately obvious
words.exampleEn: Poverty is often the underlying cause of early school leaving.
words.exampleUz: Qashshoqlik ko'pincha maktabni erta tashlab ketishning asosiy sababi bo'ladi.

words.translation: eng og'ir zarbani o'z zimmasiga olmoq
words.definitionEn: to suffer the worst part of something bad
words.exampleEn: Low-income families bear the brunt of rising food prices.
words.exampleUz: Oziq-ovqat narxi oshishining eng og'ir zarbasi kam ta'minlangan oilalarga tushadi.

words.definitionEn: a discussion in which people argue strongly and emotionally
words.exampleEn: The new exam rules sparked a heated debate among teachers.
words.exampleUz: Yangi imtihon qoidalari o'qituvchilar orasida qizg'in bahsga sabab bo'ldi.

words.definitionEn: to make a confusing subject easier to understand, usually with new information
words.exampleEn: Recent research has shed light on how sleep affects memory.
words.exampleUz: So'nggi tadqiqotlar uyquning xotiraga ta'siriga oydinlik kiritdi.

words.definitionEn: something that must be dealt with immediately
words.exampleEn: There is a pressing need for better public transport in growing cities.
words.exampleUz: O'sib borayotgan shaharlarda yaxshiroq jamoat transportiga shoshilinch ehtiyoj bor.

words.definitionEn: to gradually weaken someone's belief in themselves or in a system
words.exampleEn: Constant criticism can undermine a learner's confidence very quickly.
words.exampleUz: Doimiy tanqid o'quvchining o'ziga bo'lgan ishonchini juda tez susaytiradi.

words.definitionEn: a large amount of money, time or effort put into something
words.exampleEn: Modernising the railway requires a substantial investment from the state.
words.exampleUz: Temir yo'lni zamonaviylashtirish davlatdan salmoqli sarmoya talab qiladi.

words.definitionEn: to enjoy the good results of earlier work or investment
words.exampleEn: Countries that invested in education early are now reaping the benefits.
words.exampleUz: Ta'limga erta sarmoya kiritgan davlatlar bugun uning samarasini ko'rmoqda.

words.definitionEn: a society in which the share of older people is rising; a standard topic phrase in society essays
words.exampleEn: An ageing population puts pressure on the healthcare system.
words.exampleUz: Aholining qarishi sog'liqni saqlash tizimiga bosim o'tkazadi.

words.definitionEn: to officially introduce rules that limit what people can do
words.exampleEn: Some schools have imposed restrictions on the use of phones in class.
words.exampleUz: Ba'zi maktablar darsda telefondan foydalanishga cheklovlar joriy qildi.

words.definitionEn: used to say that something is largely but not completely true; softens a strong claim
words.exampleEn: To a considerable extent, success at university depends on self-discipline.
words.exampleUz: Universitetdagi muvaffaqiyat ancha darajada o'z-o'zini nazorat qilishga bog'liq.

words.definitionEn: to create conditions in which new ideas can develop
words.exampleEn: Project work fosters creativity far more than memorising rules.
words.exampleUz: Loyihaviy ish qoidalarni yodlashdan ko'ra ijodkorlikni ancha yaxshi rivojlantiradi.

words.definitionEn: to widen your experience and understanding of the world
words.exampleEn: Studying abroad broadens your horizons in ways a textbook never can.
words.exampleUz: Chet elda o'qish dunyoqarashingizni darslik hech qachon kengaytira olmaydigan darajada kengaytiradi.

words.definitionEn: pressure that keeps increasing over time
words.exampleEn: Teachers face mounting pressure to prepare students for standardised tests.
words.exampleUz: O'qituvchilar o'quvchilarni standart testlarga tayyorlash bo'yicha kuchayib borayotgan bosimga duch kelmoqda.

words.definitionEn: to decide officially how money, staff or materials will be used
words.exampleEn: The ministry should allocate more resources to rural clinics.
words.exampleUz: Vazirlik qishloq shifoxonalariga ko'proq resurs ajratishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: a way of living with very little physical activity
words.exampleEn: Office work often leads to a sedentary lifestyle and health problems.
words.exampleUz: Ofis ishi ko'pincha kam harakatli turmush tarziga va salomatlik muammolariga olib keladi.

words.definitionEn: to make poverty less severe, though not to remove it completely
words.exampleEn: Micro-loans have helped alleviate poverty in many rural districts.
words.exampleUz: Mikroqarzlar ko'plab qishloq tumanlarida qashshoqlikni yumshatishga yordam berdi.

words.definitionEn: a part that is so necessary that the whole would not work without it
words.exampleEn: Feedback is an integral part of the learning process.
words.exampleUz: Fikr-mulohaza o'quv jarayonining ajralmas qismidir.

words.definitionEn: to use your power to affect what other people think or do
words.exampleEn: Advertising exerts a powerful influence on what children want to buy.
words.exampleUz: Reklama bolalar nima sotib olishni xohlashiga kuchli ta'sir o'tkazadi.

words.definitionEn: a very clear and often shocking difference between two things
words.exampleEn: There is a stark contrast between city salaries and village incomes.
words.exampleUz: Shahar maoshlari bilan qishloq daromadlari o'rtasida keskin farq bor.

words.definitionEn: to gradually teach someone to accept certain principles
words.exampleEn: Families instil values such as honesty long before school does.
words.exampleUz: Oila halollik kabi qadriyatlarni maktabdan ancha oldin singdiradi.

words.definitionEn: to stop people from doing something by making them afraid of the result
words.exampleEn: Higher fines act as a deterrent to dangerous driving.
words.exampleUz: Yuqori jarimalar xavfli haydashdan qaytaruvchi omil bo'lib xizmat qiladi.

words.definitionEn: to take serious action against global warming
words.exampleEn: No single country can tackle climate change on its own.
words.exampleUz: Hech bir davlat iqlim o'zgarishiga yolg'iz o'zi qarshi tura olmaydi.

words.definitionEn: a slow but continuous fall in a number or quality
words.exampleEn: There has been a steady decline in the number of people reading printed books.
words.exampleUz: Bosma kitob o'qiydiganlar soni barqaror ravishda kamayib bormoqda.

words.definitionEn: to treat one aspect as especially important
words.exampleEn: Modern curricula place greater emphasis on critical thinking than on memory.
words.exampleUz: Zamonaviy o'quv dasturlari xotiradan ko'ra tanqidiy fikrlashga ko'proq urg'u beradi.

words.definitionEn: a result that nobody planned or wanted
words.exampleEn: One unintended consequence of cheap flights is the damage to the environment.
words.exampleUz: Arzon parvozlarning kutilmagan oqibatlaridan biri atrof-muhitga yetkazilgan zarardir.

words.definitionEn: an action that destroys the confidence someone had in you
words.exampleEn: Selling users' data without permission is a serious breach of trust.
words.exampleUz: Foydalanuvchilar ma'lumotini ruxsatsiz sotish ishonchni jiddiy buzish hisoblanadi.

words.word: to cater for the needs of
words.definitionEn: to provide what a particular group of people requires
words.exampleEn: Good schools cater for the needs of both fast and slow learners.
words.exampleUz: Yaxshi maktablar tez ham, sekin ham o'zlashtiradigan o'quvchilar ehtiyojini qondiradi.

words.definitionEn: a worry that is reasonable and fair, even if you disagree with the conclusion
words.exampleEn: Parents have a legitimate concern about what their children see online.
words.exampleUz: Ota-onalarning bolalari internetda nima ko'rishi haqidagi xavotiri asosli.

words.definitionEn: to grow stronger and develop faster, especially about a movement or trend
words.exampleEn: The campaign for cleaner air has gained momentum in recent years.
words.exampleUz: Toza havo uchun harakat so'nggi yillarda ancha kuchaydi.

words.definitionEn: a very large amount of useful experience
words.exampleEn: Older employees bring a wealth of experience to a young team.
words.exampleUz: Katta yoshdagi xodimlar yosh jamoaga boy tajriba olib keladi.

words.definitionEn: to make people less certain that something is true or reliable
words.exampleEn: New data casts doubt on the claim that homework improves results.
words.exampleUz: Yangi ma'lumotlar uy vazifasi natijani yaxshilaydi degan fikrni shubha ostiga qo'ymoqda.

words.definitionEn: harmful results; a formal alternative to 'bad effects'
words.exampleEn: Excessive screen time has adverse effects on children's sleep.
words.exampleUz: Ekran oldida haddan ortiq vaqt o'tkazish bolalar uyqusiga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: to point out that two different situations are similar
words.exampleEn: You can draw a parallel between learning a language and learning an instrument.
words.exampleUz: Til o'rganish bilan cholg'u asbobini o'rganish o'rtasida o'xshashlik ko'rsatish mumkin.

words.definitionEn: a careful and strict way of doing something, leaving no room for mistakes
words.exampleEn: Medical research demands a rigorous approach to testing.
words.exampleUz: Tibbiy tadqiqot sinovlarga puxta yondashuvni talab qiladi.

words.definitionEn: to create the conditions that make a later development possible
words.exampleEn: Cheap smartphones paved the way for mobile banking in the region.
words.exampleUz: Arzon smartfonlar mintaqada mobil banking uchun yo'l ochib berdi.

words.definitionEn: a sudden, large increase; essential for describing charts and trends
words.exampleEn: There was a sharp rise in online shopping after the pandemic.
words.exampleUz: Pandemiyadan keyin onlayn xaridlar keskin o'sdi.

words.definitionEn: to say publicly that you are worried about something
words.exampleEn: Several scientists have voiced concerns about unregulated artificial intelligence.
words.exampleUz: Bir necha olim nazoratsiz sun'iy intellekt bo'yicha xavotirini bildirdi.

words.definitionEn: an amount or degree never reached before
words.exampleEn: Information is now available at an unprecedented level of detail.
words.exampleUz: Axborot bugun misli ko'rilmagan darajada batafsil mavjud.

words.word: to weigh up the pros and cons
words.translation: ijobiy va salbiy tomonlarini taroziga solmoq
words.definitionEn: to consider the advantages and disadvantages before deciding
words.exampleEn: Before moving abroad, you should weigh up the pros and cons carefully.
words.exampleUz: Chet elga ko'chishdan oldin ijobiy va salbiy tomonlarini diqqat bilan taroziga solish kerak.

words.definitionEn: the main thing that causes something to develop or happen
words.exampleEn: Technology has been the driving force behind changes in the job market.
words.exampleUz: Texnologiya mehnat bozoridagi o'zgarishlarning harakatlantiruvchi kuchi bo'ldi.

words.definitionEn: to be less good than people hoped
words.exampleEn: The reform improved attendance but fell short of expectations on quality.
words.exampleUz: Islohot davomatni yaxshiladi, biroq sifat bo'yicha kutilganidan pastroq chiqdi.

words.definitionEn: a subject that people are discussing urgently right now
words.exampleEn: Water shortage has become a burning issue in Central Asia.
words.exampleUz: Suv tanqisligi Markaziy Osiyoda dolzarb masalaga aylandi.

words.definitionEn: to obey official rules, especially in business or safety contexts
words.exampleEn: Factories must comply with strict environmental regulations.
words.exampleUz: Zavodlar qat'iy ekologik qoidalarga rioya qilishi shart.

words.definitionEn: an answer to a problem that will still work in the future, not a quick fix
words.exampleEn: Building more roads is not a long-term solution to traffic congestion.
words.exampleUz: Ko'proq yo'l qurish tirbandlikning uzoq muddatli yechimi emas.

words.definitionEn: to put yourself in a position where something bad could happen
words.exampleEn: Students who rely only on translation run the risk of losing fluency.
words.exampleUz: Faqat tarjimaga tayanadigan o'quvchilar ravonlikni yo'qotish xavfiga duchor bo'ladi.

words.definitionEn: a very strong effect that changes something deeply
words.exampleEn: The internet has had a profound effect on how we learn.
words.exampleUz: Internet biz qanday o'rganishimizga chuqur ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

words.definitionEn: to do something for the first time so that others may follow it later
words.exampleEn: Allowing one company to pollute freely would set a dangerous precedent.
words.exampleUz: Bitta kompaniyaga erkin ifloslantirishga ruxsat berish xavfli o'rnak yaratadi.

words.definitionEn: accepted as true by most people; a strong, safe way to introduce a fact in writing
words.exampleEn: It is widely acknowledged that early education shapes future success.
words.exampleUz: Erta ta'lim kelajakdagi muvaffaqiyatni belgilashi keng e'tirof etilgan.

words.definitionEn: to control and reduce harmful gases released into the air
words.exampleEn: Electric buses are one practical way to curb emissions in big cities.
words.exampleUz: Elektr avtobuslar yirik shaharlarda zararli gaz chiqishini cheklashning amaliy yo'llaridan biri.

words.definitionEn: an indirect result that spreads from one situation to another
words.exampleEn: Higher fuel prices have a knock-on effect on the cost of food.
words.exampleUz: Yoqilg'i narxining oshishi oziq-ovqat narxiga zanjirli ta'sir ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: to gather knowledge gradually over a long period
words.exampleEn: Reading widely allows you to accumulate knowledge across many fields.
words.exampleUz: Ko'p mutolaa qilish turli sohalarda bilim to'plash imkonini beradi.

words.definitionEn: a reason that seems reasonable and could well be true
words.exampleEn: The most plausible explanation for the drop is the rise in tuition fees.
words.exampleUz: Pasayishning eng ishonarli izohi o'qish to'lovining oshishidir.

words.definitionEn: to give a lot of time to one activity because you think it matters
words.exampleEn: She devotes two hours a day to preparing for the multilevel exam.
words.exampleUz: U multilevel imtihoniga tayyorgarlik uchun kuniga ikki soat ajratadi.

words.definitionEn: a difficulty that continues despite attempts to solve it
words.exampleEn: Youth unemployment remains a persistent problem in many countries.
words.exampleUz: Yoshlar bandligi ko'p davlatlarda hamon bartaraf bo'lmayotgan muammo.

words.definitionEn: to improve how much useful work is done in a given time
words.exampleEn: Flexible hours can enhance productivity more than longer working days.
words.exampleUz: Moslashuvchan ish vaqti uzoq ish kunidan ko'ra unumdorlikni yaxshiroq oshiradi.

words.definitionEn: a deep change in the way something is organised or understood
words.exampleEn: Remote work represents a fundamental shift in how offices operate.
words.exampleUz: Masofaviy ish ofislar faoliyatidagi tub o'zgarishni anglatadi.

words.definitionEn: to become known and respected for what you have done
words.exampleEn: Uzbek craftspeople are gaining recognition on international markets.
words.exampleUz: O'zbek hunarmandlari xalqaro bozorlarda e'tirof qozonmoqda.

words.definitionEn: a situation in which someone depends on one thing too much
words.exampleEn: A heavy reliance on private cars has made the air far dirtier.
words.exampleUz: Shaxsiy avtomobillarga haddan ortiq bog'liqlik havoni ancha ifloslantirdi.

words.definitionEn: to be treated as more important than something else
words.exampleEn: In my view, health should take priority over economic growth.
words.exampleUz: Menimcha, salomatlik iqtisodiy o'sishdan ustun turishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: to cause people to start arguing publicly about an issue
words.exampleEn: The new dress code triggered a debate about personal freedom.
words.exampleUz: Yangi kiyinish qoidasi shaxsiy erkinlik haqidagi bahsga sabab bo'ldi.

words.definitionEn: a difficulty that is very hard, though not impossible, to overcome
words.exampleEn: Feeding a growing population is a formidable challenge for agriculture.
words.exampleUz: O'sib borayotgan aholini oziq-ovqat bilan ta'minlash qishloq xo'jaligi uchun nihoyatda og'ir sinov.

words.definitionEn: to gradually destroy people's confidence in an institution or person
words.exampleEn: Fake news slowly erodes trust in traditional media.
words.exampleUz: Soxta yangiliklar an'anaviy ommaviy axborot vositalariga bo'lgan ishonchni asta-sekin yemiradi.

words.definitionEn: a large collection of research findings pointing in the same direction
words.exampleEn: A growing body of evidence links long screen time to poor concentration.
words.exampleUz: Ekran oldida uzoq o'tirishni yomon diqqat bilan bog'lovchi dalillar tobora ko'paymoqda.

words.definitionEn: to accept behaviour or results because of special circumstances
words.exampleEn: Teachers should make allowances for students who work night shifts.
words.exampleUz: O'qituvchilar tunda ishlaydigan talabalarning holatini hisobga olishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: to act quickly to take advantage of a chance
words.exampleEn: She seized the opportunity to join an exchange programme in Germany.
words.exampleUz: U Germaniyadagi almashinuv dasturiga qo'shilish imkoniyatidan foydalanib qoldi.

words.definitionEn: the element that most strongly determines the outcome
words.exampleEn: Motivation is often the decisive factor in language learning.
words.exampleUz: Til o'rganishda ko'pincha motivatsiya hal qiluvchi omil bo'ladi.

words.definitionEn: to produce the outcome that was hoped for, usually after some time
words.exampleEn: The reading programme began to yield results after only one term.
words.exampleUz: Mutolaa dasturi atigi bir chorakdan keyin natija bera boshladi.

words.definitionEn: something that worries people and needs attention; a neutral, formal phrase for essays
words.exampleEn: The falling number of science teachers is a matter of concern.
words.exampleUz: Aniq fanlar o'qituvchilari sonining kamayishi tashvishga soladigan masala.

words.definitionEn: to explain the reason for something, or to form a particular part of a total
words.exampleEn: Poor teaching materials account for much of the gap in exam results.
words.exampleUz: Imtihon natijalaridagi tafovutning katta qismi sifatsiz o'quv materiallari bilan izohlanadi.

words.definitionEn: to have one simple point as the real essence of a complicated issue
words.exampleEn: The whole debate boils down to one question: who pays for it?
words.exampleUz: Butun bahs bitta savolga borib taqaladi: buning haqini kim to'laydi?

words.definitionEn: to be caused by something; a formal way of showing origin
words.exampleEn: Many social problems stem from a lack of decent jobs.
words.exampleUz: Ko'plab ijtimoiy muammolar munosib ish o'rinlari yetishmasligidan kelib chiqadi.

words.definitionEn: to stop using something gradually over a planned period
words.exampleEn: The government plans to phase out single-use plastic bags by 2030.
words.exampleUz: Hukumat 2030-yilgacha bir martalik plastik paketlardan bosqichma-bosqich voz kechishni rejalashtirmoqda.

words.definitionEn: to make something happen, especially a change
words.exampleEn: Social media has brought about a complete change in political campaigns.
words.exampleUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar siyosiy kampaniyalarda tubdan o'zgarish keltirib chiqardi.

words.definitionEn: to depend completely on one particular thing
words.exampleEn: The success of the project hinges on getting enough funding.
words.exampleUz: Loyihaning muvaffaqiyati yetarli mablag' olinishiga butunlay bog'liq.

words.definitionEn: to mention a subject briefly without going into detail
words.exampleEn: The lecture touched on ethics but focused mainly on technology.
words.exampleUz: Ma'ruzada axloq masalasiga qisqacha to'xtalib o'tildi, asosiy e'tibor esa texnologiyaga qaratildi.

words.definitionEn: to suggest an idea or plan formally so that others can discuss it
words.exampleEn: Several experts have put forward a plan to reform the exam system.
words.exampleUz: Bir necha mutaxassis imtihon tizimini isloh qilish rejasini ilgari surdi.

words.definitionEn: to use your knowledge, experience or resources as a source
words.exampleEn: In her essay she drew on her own experience of studying abroad.
words.exampleUz: Inshosida u chet elda o'qish bo'yicha shaxsiy tajribasiga tayandi.

words.definitionEn: to choose one person or thing from a group for special attention
words.exampleEn: It is unfair to single out one student for the whole group's mistake.
words.exampleUz: Butun guruh xatosi uchun bitta talabani alohida ajratib ayblash adolatsizlik.

words.definitionEn: to plan carefully how something will develop step by step
words.exampleEn: Before the exam I mapped out a twelve-week study plan.
words.exampleUz: Imtihon oldidan o'n ikki haftalik o'quv rejasini batafsil tuzib chiqdim.

words.definitionEn: to quickly improve a skill you already have but have not used recently
words.exampleEn: I need to brush up on my writing before the multilevel exam.
words.exampleUz: Multilevel imtihonidan oldin yozish ko'nikmamni yangilab olishim kerak.

words.definitionEn: to reduce the amount of something you use or consume
words.exampleEn: Cutting down on meat is one way to reduce your carbon footprint.
words.exampleUz: Go'sht iste'molini kamaytirish uglerod izini qisqartirish yo'llaridan biri.

words.definitionEn: to get rid of a rule, system or practice completely
words.exampleEn: Some experts argue that we should do away with school uniforms.
words.exampleUz: Ba'zi mutaxassislar maktab formasini butunlay bekor qilish kerak deb hisoblaydi.

words.definitionEn: to use something as a second choice when the first one fails
words.exampleEn: If the internet fails, teachers can fall back on printed worksheets.
words.exampleUz: Internet uzilib qolsa, o'qituvchilar zaxira sifatida bosma topshiriqlardan foydalanishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: to find a way of dealing with a problem or avoiding a rule
words.exampleEn: Students quickly find ways to get around website blocks.
words.exampleUz: O'quvchilar sayt bloklarini chetlab o'tish yo'lini tezda topib olishadi.

words.definitionEn: to cause something, usually something unwelcome, to begin
words.exampleEn: Rapid urban growth has given rise to serious housing shortages.
words.exampleUz: Shaharlarning tez o'sishi jiddiy uy-joy tanqisligiga sabab bo'ldi.

words.definitionEn: to solve small problems or disagreements so that something works smoothly
words.exampleEn: The team spent a week ironing out problems in the new app.
words.exampleUz: Jamoa yangi ilovadagi kamchiliklarni bartaraf etishga bir hafta sarfladi.

words.definitionEn: to stay at the same level or speed as something that is changing fast
words.exampleEn: It is hard for older workers to keep up with new software.
words.exampleUz: Katta yoshdagi xodimlarga yangi dasturlardan ortda qolmay yurish qiyin.

words.definitionEn: to end someone's employment because there is not enough work, not because of poor performance
words.exampleEn: The factory laid off two hundred workers when orders fell.
words.exampleUz: Buyurtmalar kamayganda zavod ikki yuz ishchini qisqartirdi.

words.definitionEn: to be as good as people expected or hoped
words.exampleEn: The new course did not quite live up to its reputation.
words.exampleUz: Yangi kurs o'z obro'sini to'liq oqlamadi.

words.definitionEn: to investigate a problem or question in order to find out the facts
words.exampleEn: The university is looking into why so many first-year students drop out.
words.exampleUz: Universitet nega birinchi kurs talabalari ko'p tashlab ketayotganini o'rganmoqda.

words.definitionEn: to choose formally not to take part in something you could join
words.exampleEn: Parents may opt out of the extra Saturday classes.
words.exampleUz: Ota-onalar shanba kunidagi qo'shimcha darslarda qatnashmaslikni tanlashi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: to describe or identify something exactly, when it is hard to define
words.exampleEn: It is difficult to pin down exactly why the results improved.
words.exampleUz: Natijalar nega yaxshilanganini aniq belgilash qiyin.

words.definitionEn: to accept an unpleasant situation without complaining
words.exampleEn: Commuters put up with an hour of traffic every morning.
words.exampleUz: Har kuni ertalab ishga qatnovchilar bir soatlik tirbandlikka chidashadi.

words.definitionEn: to introduce a new product or service to more and more people
words.exampleEn: The ministry will roll out the new curriculum across all regions.
words.exampleUz: Vazirlik yangi o'quv dasturini barcha viloyatlarda joriy qiladi.

words.definitionEn: to reduce the size or ambition of a plan, usually to save money
words.exampleEn: The company scaled back its expansion plans after a weak year.
words.exampleUz: Kompaniya sust yildan keyin kengayish rejalarini qisqartirdi.

words.translation: aniq bayon qilmoq; niyat qilib kirishmoq
words.definitionEn: to explain ideas clearly in writing, or to begin doing something with a clear aim
words.exampleEn: The report sets out three practical steps for reducing waste.
words.exampleUz: Hisobotda chiqindini kamaytirishning uchta amaliy qadami aniq bayon qilingan.

words.definitionEn: to explain something in a very clear and detailed way
words.exampleEn: The teacher spelled out exactly how the essay would be marked.
words.exampleUz: O'qituvchi insho qanday baholanishini nuqtama-nuqta tushuntirib berdi.

words.definitionEn: to leave an important position voluntarily
words.exampleEn: The director stepped down after ten years in charge.
words.exampleUz: Direktor o'n yillik rahbarlikdan so'ng lavozimdan ketdi.

words.definitionEn: to increase the level of an effort or activity
words.exampleEn: Cities need to step up their efforts to plant more trees.
words.exampleUz: Shaharlar ko'proq daraxt ekish bo'yicha sa'y-harakatlarini kuchaytirishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: to continue following a plan, rule or subject without changing
words.exampleEn: If you stick to a routine, progress becomes almost automatic.
words.exampleUz: Belgilangan tartibga amal qilsangiz, taraqqiyot deyarli o'z-o'zidan keladi.

words.definitionEn: to accept a new responsibility, or to employ someone
words.exampleEn: Young managers often take on more work than they can handle.
words.exampleUz: Yosh menejerlar ko'pincha uddalay olmaydigan darajada ko'p ish zimmasiga oladi.

words.definitionEn: to start a new hobby or activity, or to occupy space or time
words.exampleEn: Many adults take up a musical instrument to reduce stress.
words.exampleUz: Ko'p kattalar stressni kamaytirish uchun cholg'u asbobini o'rgana boshlaydi.

words.definitionEn: to make use of a source of energy, money, talent or interest that already exists
words.exampleEn: Online platforms let small businesses tap into international markets.
words.exampleUz: Onlayn platformalar kichik biznesga xalqaro bozor imkoniyatidan foydalanish imkonini beradi.

words.definitionEn: to fit well together with another fact, idea or plan
words.exampleEn: These findings tie in with earlier research on sleep and memory.
words.exampleUz: Bu natijalar uyqu va xotira bo'yicha oldingi tadqiqotlarga mos keladi.

words.definitionEn: to refuse an offer, request or application
words.exampleEn: He turned down a well-paid job in order to finish his degree.
words.exampleUz: U diplomini tugatish uchun yaxshi maoshli ishni rad etdi.

words.definitionEn: to prove to be true or to end in a particular way, often unexpectedly
words.exampleEn: The rumour turned out to be completely false.
words.exampleUz: Mish-mish butunlay yolg'on bo'lib chiqdi.

words.definitionEn: to gradually disappear, especially about a feeling or effect
words.exampleEn: The excitement of a new job usually wears off after a few months.
words.exampleUz: Yangi ishdan olingan hayajon odatda bir necha oydan keyin so'nadi.

words.definitionEn: to reduce a large number of possibilities to a smaller, clearer set
words.exampleEn: I narrowed down my choices to three universities.
words.exampleUz: Tanlovimni uchta universitetgacha toraytirdim.

words.definitionEn: to divide something into smaller parts for analysis, or to stop working
words.exampleEn: Let me break down the problem into three separate causes.
words.exampleUz: Muammoni uchta alohida sababga ajratib ko'rsataman.

words.definitionEn: to increase gradually over time
words.exampleEn: You build up fluency by speaking a little every single day.
words.exampleUz: Ravonlikni har kuni ozgina gapirish orqali asta-sekin to'playsiz.

words.definitionEn: to publicly demand something, or to require a particular action
words.exampleEn: Experts are calling for stricter rules on advertising to children.
words.exampleUz: Mutaxassislar bolalarga qaratilgan reklamaga qat'iyroq qoidalar joriy etishni talab qilmoqda.

words.definitionEn: to start to experience something unpleasant such as pressure or criticism
words.exampleEn: The airline came under heavy criticism for its delays.
words.exampleUz: Aviakompaniya kechikishlari uchun qattiq tanqidga uchradi.

words.definitionEn: to start dealing with bad behaviour in a much stricter way
words.exampleEn: Police have cracked down on drivers who use phones at the wheel.
words.exampleUz: Politsiya rulda telefon ishlatuvchi haydovchilarga nisbatan qattiq chora ko'ra boshladi.

words.definitionEn: to spend too much time thinking or speaking about one thing, usually negative
words.exampleEn: Rather than dwelling on failure, successful students analyse it and move on.
words.exampleUz: Muvaffaqiyatli talabalar mag'lubiyatga o'ralashib qolmay, uni tahlil qilib oldinga yuradi.

words.definitionEn: to start something new and important, often long or difficult
words.exampleEn: At thirty she embarked on a completely new career in medicine.
words.exampleUz: O'ttiz yoshida u tibbiyotda mutlaqo yangi karyerani boshladi.

words.definitionEn: to include something as part of a calculation or decision
words.exampleEn: When you compare salaries, you must factor in the cost of living.
words.exampleUz: Maoshlarni solishtirganda yashash xarajatini ham hisobga olish kerak.

words.definitionEn: to take further action after an earlier step to make sure it works
words.exampleEn: Teachers should follow up on feedback in the next lesson.
words.exampleUz: O'qituvchilar berilgan fikr-mulohaza ustida keyingi darsda ham ishlashi kerak.

words.definitionEn: to avoid discussing something difficult by mentioning it only briefly
words.exampleEn: The report glosses over the cost of the whole programme.
words.exampleUz: Hisobotda butun dasturning narxi yuzaki o'tib ketilgan.

words.definitionEn: to prevent someone or something from progressing, or to stop yourself saying something
words.exampleEn: Weak English can hold back otherwise talented professionals.
words.exampleUz: Zaif ingliz tili iqtidorli mutaxassislarning o'sishiga to'sqinlik qilishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: to stop rising or falling and stay at the same level; very useful for describing graphs
words.exampleEn: After a rapid rise, the number of users levelled off in 2024.
words.exampleUz: Tez o'sishdan so'ng foydalanuvchilar soni 2024-yilda barqarorlashdi.

words.definitionEn: to make something seem less important or serious than it really is
words.exampleEn: Officials played down the scale of the water shortage.
words.exampleUz: Rasmiylar suv tanqisligi ko'lamini kamaytirib ko'rsatishdi.

words.definitionEn: to try hard and repeatedly to achieve a particular change
words.exampleEn: Students are pushing for more practical subjects in the curriculum.
words.exampleUz: Talabalar o'quv dasturiga ko'proq amaliy fanlar kiritilishini qat'iy talab qilmoqda.

words.definitionEn: to unexpectedly meet a difficulty or a person
words.exampleEn: The project ran into difficulties as soon as the funding stopped.
words.exampleUz: Moliyalashtirish to'xtashi bilanoq loyiha qiyinchiliklarga duch keldi.

words.definitionEn: to avoid doing something because you are nervous about it
words.exampleEn: Many learners shy away from speaking because they fear mistakes.
words.exampleUz: Ko'p o'rganuvchilar xato qilishdan qo'rqib, gapirishdan qochadi.

words.definitionEn: to be clearly better or more noticeable than others
words.exampleEn: Volunteering experience helps a CV stand out from the rest.
words.exampleUz: Ko'ngillilik tajribasi rezyumening boshqalardan ajralib turishiga yordam beradi.

words.definitionEn: to gain control of something, or to replace someone in a role
words.exampleEn: People fear that machines will take over most routine jobs.
words.exampleUz: Odamlar mashinalar ko'pchilik oddiy ishlarning o'rnini egallashidan qo'rqadi.

words.definitionEn: to make a proposal or rule weaker and less effective
words.exampleEn: The original law was watered down after pressure from businesses.
words.exampleUz: Dastlabki qonun biznes bosimidan keyin ancha yumshatildi.

words.definitionEn: something that has both clear advantages and clear disadvantages; neutral register, excellent in Speaking Part 3 and in essays
words.exampleEn: Social media is a double-edged sword: it connects people but also spreads misinformation.
words.exampleUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoq ikki tomoni o'tkir pichoq: u odamlarni bog'laydi, ammo yolg'on axborotni ham tarqatadi.

words.definitionEn: to cause gradual damage, especially to health or quality; neutral register, safe in both Speaking and Writing
words.exampleEn: Long working hours eventually take their toll on family life.
words.exampleUz: Uzoq ish soatlari oxir-oqibat oilaviy hayotga salbiy ta'sirini ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: only the small visible part of a much bigger problem; neutral register, fine in formal Writing
words.exampleEn: The reported cases of cheating are just the tip of the iceberg.
words.exampleUz: Qayd etilgan ko'chirish holatlari muammoning arzimas bir qismi xolos.

words.definitionEn: over a long future period, in contrast to immediate effects; neutral register, very safe in essays
words.exampleEn: Investing in teacher training pays off in the long run.
words.exampleUz: O'qituvchilarni tayyorlashga sarmoya kiritish uzoq muddatda o'zini oqlaydi.

words.definitionEn: a situation where the rules are unclear and it is hard to say what is right; neutral register, good for ethics questions
words.exampleEn: Using AI to write part of an essay is still a grey area for many universities.
words.exampleUz: Inshoning bir qismini sun'iy intellektga yozdirish ko'p universitetlar uchun hamon noaniq soha.

words.definitionEn: to join an activity only because it has become popular; slightly informal, fine in Speaking Part 3, avoid in very formal Writing
words.exampleEn: Many companies jumped on the bandwagon and called their products 'green'.
words.exampleUz: Ko'p kompaniyalar modaga ergashib, mahsulotlarini 'ekologik' deb atay boshladi.

words.definitionEn: to find new and creative solutions instead of the obvious ones; informal to neutral, good in Speaking, use sparingly in Writing
words.exampleEn: Employers now look for graduates who can think outside the box.
words.exampleUz: Ish beruvchilar endi qolipdan tashqari fikrlay oladigan bitiruvchilarni qidiradi.

words.definitionEn: something that seems bad at first but turns out to be good; neutral register, ideal for personal stories in Speaking Part 2
words.exampleEn: Failing that interview was a blessing in disguise, because I found a better job.
words.exampleUz: O'sha suhbatdan o'tolmaganim aslida yaxshilik bo'ldi, chunki men undan yaxshiroq ish topdim.

words.definitionEn: to do something in a cheaper or faster way that lowers quality; neutral register, safe in Speaking and Writing
words.exampleEn: Builders who cut corners put people's lives at risk.
words.exampleUz: Ishni chala qiladigan quruvchilar odamlar hayotini xavf ostiga qo'yadi.

words.definitionEn: something that helps you move to a better position later; neutral register, common in work and study answers
words.exampleEn: For many students, a part-time job is a stepping stone to a career.
words.exampleUz: Ko'p talabalar uchun yarim kunlik ish karyeraga o'tish poyasi bo'lib xizmat qiladi.

words.definitionEn: an idea worth thinking about seriously; neutral register, useful when reacting to an opinion in Speaking Part 3
words.exampleEn: That documentary about waste really gave me food for thought.
words.exampleUz: Chiqindilar haqidagi o'sha hujjatli film menga chinakam o'ylash uchun oziq berdi.

words.definitionEn: to begin to understand and deal with something difficult; neutral register, safe everywhere
words.exampleEn: It took me a month to get to grips with academic writing.
words.exampleUz: Akademik yozuvni yaxshilab o'zlashtirishim uchun bir oy kerak bo'ldi.

words.definitionEn: a situation in which everyone competes under the same fair conditions; neutral register, excellent for education and economy topics
words.exampleEn: Free exam preparation creates a level playing field for poorer students.
words.exampleUz: Bepul imtihon tayyorgarligi kambag'al o'quvchilar uchun teng imkoniyat yaratadi.

words.definitionEn: to be so familiar that you do it without thinking; neutral register, natural in Speaking Part 1-3
words.exampleEn: After two years abroad, speaking English became second nature to him.
words.exampleUz: Chet elda ikki yildan so'ng ingliz tilida gapirish unga odatga aylanib ketdi.

words.definitionEn: to develop or change as fast as something else; neutral register, fine in formal Writing
words.exampleEn: Salaries have not kept pace with the rising cost of housing.
words.exampleUz: Maoshlar uy-joy narxining o'sish sur'atiga yetib bormadi.

words.definitionEn: extremely different from each other; neutral register, useful for comparison questions
words.exampleEn: Life in a big city and life in a small village are worlds apart.
words.exampleUz: Katta shahardagi hayot bilan kichik qishloqdagi hayot yer bilan osmoncha farq qiladi.

words.definitionEn: at a point where an important decision must be made; neutral register, strong in Speaking Part 2 narratives
words.exampleEn: After graduation I was at a crossroads between studying further and finding work.
words.exampleUz: Bitirgach, o'qishni davom ettirish bilan ish topish o'rtasidagi hal qiluvchi tanlov oldida qoldim.

words.definitionEn: something that requires great effort over a long time; neutral register, safe in both papers
words.exampleEn: Persuading people to give up their cars is an uphill struggle.
words.exampleUz: Odamlarni mashinadan voz kechishga ko'ndirish mashaqqatli kurash.

words.definitionEn: an amount far too small to make a real difference; neutral register, good for scale arguments
words.exampleEn: Planting a hundred trees is a drop in the ocean compared with what is cut down.
words.exampleUz: Yuzta daraxt ekish kesilayotganiga nisbatan dengizdan bir tomchi.

words.definitionEn: to produce a good result after effort or risk; neutral register, natural everywhere
words.exampleEn: All those early mornings of study finally paid off.
words.exampleUz: O'sha barvaqt turib o'qishlar nihoyat o'zini oqladi.

words.definitionEn: to agree completely with someone, usually used in the negative; informal to neutral, best in Speaking
words.exampleEn: Parents and teenagers rarely see eye to eye about screen time.
words.exampleUz: Ota-onalar va o'smirlar ekran vaqti borasida kamdan-kam bir fikrga keladi.

words.definitionEn: to do something that has never been done before; neutral to formal, suitable for Writing
words.exampleEn: The study broke new ground in the treatment of childhood asthma.
words.exampleUz: Tadqiqot bolalar astmasini davolashda yangilik ochdi.

words.definitionEn: in the same difficult situation as other people; informal, ideal for Speaking Part 1-3, avoid in formal essays
words.exampleEn: Every candidate is nervous, so we are all in the same boat.
words.exampleUz: Har bir nomzod hayajonlanadi, demak hammamiz bir xil ahvoldamiz.

words.word: to bite off more than you can chew
words.phonetic: /baɪt ɒf ˌmɔː ðən jə kən ˈtʃuː/
words.definitionEn: to take on more work than you are able to manage; informal, fine in Speaking, avoid in formal Writing
words.exampleEn: I bit off more than I could chew by taking two courses at once.
words.exampleUz: Bir vaqtning o'zida ikkita kursga yozilib, kuchim yetmaydigan ishga qo'l urdim.

words.definitionEn: an event that warns people they must change; neutral register, strong in environment and health essays
words.exampleEn: The heatwave was a wake-up call about the reality of climate change.
words.exampleUz: Jazirama issiq iqlim o'zgarishi haqiqati haqida ogohlantiruvchi signal bo'ldi.

words.definitionEn: doing something in a way that is likely to succeed; neutral register, safe in Speaking and Writing
words.exampleEn: The new recycling scheme shows the city is on the right track.
words.exampleUz: Yangi qayta ishlash tizimi shahar to'g'ri yo'lda ekanini ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: to happen together and be closely connected; neutral register, excellent for cause-effect essays
words.exampleEn: Economic growth and environmental damage often go hand in hand.
words.exampleUz: Iqtisodiy o'sish va ekologik zarar ko'pincha yonma-yon keladi.

words.definitionEn: to fail to appreciate something because it is always available; neutral register, safe everywhere
words.exampleEn: We take clean drinking water for granted until there is a shortage.
words.exampleUz: Tanqislik yuz bermaguncha toza ichimlik suvining qadriga yetmaymiz.

words.definitionEn: a subject many people are discussing at the moment; informal to neutral, best in Speaking
words.exampleEn: Artificial intelligence is a hot topic in every classroom now.
words.exampleUz: Sun'iy intellekt hozir har bir sinfda qizg'in muhokamadagi mavzu.

words.definitionEn: certain to happen sooner or later; neutral register, safe in both Speaking and Writing
words.exampleEn: It is only a matter of time before electric cars become the norm.
words.exampleUz: Elektromobillar odatiy holga aylanishi faqat vaqt masalasi.

words.definitionEn: to earn just enough money to cover basic needs; neutral register, standard in social and economic topics
words.exampleEn: Many young families struggle to make ends meet in big cities.
words.exampleUz: Ko'p yosh oilalar yirik shaharlarda kunini zo'rg'a o'tkazadi.

words.definitionEn: something that no longer exists or is no longer used; neutral register, useful for change-over-time answers
words.exampleEn: Paper dictionaries have almost become a thing of the past.
words.exampleUz: Qog'oz lug'atlar deyarli o'tmishga aylandi.

words.word: to have a lot on your plate
words.definitionEn: to have a great many responsibilities at the same time; informal, good in Speaking Part 1-2, avoid in Writing
words.exampleEn: With exams and a part-time job, she has a lot on her plate.
words.exampleUz: Imtihonlar va yarim kunlik ish bilan uning ishi boshidan oshib yotibdi.

words.translation: xavfli yo'l, tubanlikka olib boruvchi yo'l
words.definitionEn: a course of action that is likely to lead to something much worse; neutral register, effective in argument essays
words.exampleEn: Allowing adverts in classrooms is a slippery slope.
words.exampleUz: Sinfxonalarga reklamaga ruxsat berish xavfli yo'lning boshlanishi.

words.word: to turn a blind eye to
words.definitionEn: to deliberately ignore something wrong; neutral register, safe in Speaking and most Writing
words.exampleEn: Some employers turn a blind eye to unpaid overtime.
words.exampleUz: Ba'zi ish beruvchilar to'lanmagan qo'shimcha ish soatlarini ko'rmaganga oladi.

words.definitionEn: something with good and bad sides at the same time; neutral register, safe in formal Writing
words.exampleEn: Working from home has been a mixed blessing for many parents.
words.exampleUz: Uydan turib ishlash ko'p ota-onalar uchun ham foydali, ham muammoli bo'ldi.

words.definitionEn: to survive a very difficult period; neutral register, good for economy and business topics
words.exampleEn: Small businesses that adapted quickly weathered the storm.
words.exampleUz: Tez moslashgan kichik korxonalar qiyin davrdan omon chiqdi.

words.definitionEn: a relationship in which both sides must give something; informal to neutral, natural in Speaking Part 3
words.exampleEn: Respect between teachers and students is a two-way street.
words.exampleUz: O'qituvchi va o'quvchi o'rtasidagi hurmat ikki tomonlama bo'lishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: something you do only because it helps you achieve something else; neutral register, safe in Writing
words.exampleEn: For him the degree was simply a means to an end.
words.exampleUz: Uning uchun diplom shunchaki maqsadga erishish vositasi edi.

words.definitionEn: to stop communicating with someone, or to stop understanding a situation; neutral register
words.exampleEn: Social media makes it harder to lose touch with old classmates.
words.exampleUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar eski sinfdoshlar bilan aloqani uzishni qiyinlashtirdi.

words.definitionEn: to judge how important something really is instead of exaggerating; neutral register, useful when balancing an argument
words.exampleEn: One bad mock score is disappointing, but you have to keep things in perspective.
words.exampleUz: Bitta yomon sinov natijasi ko'ngilsiz, lekin vaziyatga xolis baho berish kerak.

words.definitionEn: to disagree with or contradict something; formal to neutral, very good in Writing
words.exampleEn: These findings are at odds with what most people believe.
words.exampleUz: Bu natijalar ko'pchilikning ishonchiga zid keladi.

words.definitionEn: to make something new possible, good or bad; neutral register, safe in both papers
words.exampleEn: A second language opens the door to far better job offers.
words.exampleUz: Ikkinchi til ancha yaxshi ish takliflariga yo'l ochib beradi.

words.definitionEn: in agreement about what should happen; informal, natural in Speaking, avoid in formal Writing
words.exampleEn: Before starting the project, the whole team must be on the same page.
words.exampleUz: Loyihani boshlashdan oldin butun jamoa bir xil tushunchada bo'lishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: to refuse to accept something beyond a certain point; neutral register, strong in ethics discussions
words.exampleEn: I support advertising, but I draw the line at targeting small children.
words.exampleUz: Men reklamani qo'llab-quvvatlayman, lekin yosh bolalarni nishonga olishga chegara qo'yaman.

words.definitionEn: a plan or combination that is very likely to fail badly; informal to neutral, effective in Speaking Part 3
words.exampleEn: Building factories without waste controls is a recipe for disaster.
words.exampleUz: Chiqindi nazoratisiz zavod qurish falokatga olib boradigan yo'l.

words.definitionEn: to be in the stronger position in a competition or argument; neutral register
words.exampleEn: Candidates with international experience have the upper hand.
words.exampleUz: Xalqaro tajribaga ega nomzodlar ustunlikka ega bo'ladi.

words.definitionEn: not told about something you should know; neutral register, safe in Speaking and Writing
words.exampleEn: Users are often kept in the dark about how their data is used.
words.exampleUz: Foydalanuvchilar ma'lumotlari qanday ishlatilishidan ko'pincha bexabar qoldiriladi.

words.definitionEn: something that completely changes how a situation works; informal to neutral, popular in technology answers
words.exampleEn: Cheap solar panels have been a game changer for rural areas.
words.exampleUz: Arzon quyosh panellari qishloq hududlari uchun vaziyatni tubdan o'zgartirdi.

words.definitionEn: a minor disadvantage that is worth accepting for a bigger benefit; neutral register, ideal for balanced arguments
words.exampleEn: Slightly higher taxes are a small price to pay for cleaner air.
words.exampleUz: Bir oz yuqori soliq toza havo uchun arzimas qurbonlik.

words.definitionEn: a situation where one problem causes another, which makes the first one worse; neutral register, excellent in cause-effect essays
words.exampleEn: Poor health leads to lost income, which leads to worse health: a vicious circle.
words.exampleUz: Yomon salomatlik daromadni yo'qotadi, bu esa salomatlikni yanada yomonlashtiradi: ayanchli aylanma.

words.definitionEn: the main obstacle preventing progress; neutral register, safe in formal Writing
words.exampleEn: The main stumbling block to reform is the lack of trained staff.
words.exampleUz: Islohotdagi asosiy to'siq malakali xodimlar yetishmasligi.

words.definitionEn: someone or something new that makes a situation much more pleasant; informal to neutral, best in Speaking
words.exampleEn: The young director was a breath of fresh air for the whole school.
words.exampleUz: Yosh direktor butun maktab uchun ruhlantiruvchi yangilik bo'ldi.

words.word: to go from strength to strength
words.definitionEn: to keep becoming more and more successful; neutral register, safe in Speaking and Writing
words.exampleEn: Since opening its IT park, the city has gone from strength to strength.
words.exampleUz: IT parki ochilganidan beri shahar yildan-yilga rivojlanib bormoqda.

words.definitionEn: a subject that people want to discuss; neutral register, useful for introducing a topic in Speaking
words.exampleEn: The four-day working week has become a real talking point.
words.exampleUz: To'rt kunlik ish haftasi chinakam muhokama mavzusiga aylandi.

words.word: to burn the candle at both ends
words.definitionEn: to exhaust yourself by working late and getting up early; informal, good in Speaking Part 1-2, avoid in formal Writing
words.exampleEn: He burned the candle at both ends for a year and his health suffered.
words.exampleUz: U bir yil davomida tinim bilmay ishladi va salomatligi yomonlashdi.

words.definitionEn: an experience that teaches you something surprising; informal to neutral, ideal for Speaking Part 2
words.exampleEn: Volunteering at the shelter was a real eye-opener for me.
words.exampleUz: Boshpanada ko'ngilli bo'lib ishlash men uchun chinakam ko'z ochuvchi tajriba bo'ldi.

words.definitionEn: very close in distance; informal to neutral, natural when describing places in Speaking Part 1-2
words.exampleEn: My university was just a stone's throw away from the metro station.
words.exampleUz: Universitetim metro bekatidan bir qadam narida edi.

words.definitionEn: to feel both positive and negative about something; neutral register, perfect for balanced opinions
words.exampleEn: I have mixed feelings about studying entirely online.
words.exampleUz: To'liq onlayn o'qishga ikkilanib qarayman.

words.word: to nip something in the bud
words.definitionEn: to stop a problem at an early stage before it grows; neutral register, safe in Speaking and Writing
words.exampleEn: Bullying must be nipped in the bud before it spreads.
words.exampleUz: Sinfdagi zo'ravonlikni tarqalib ketmasidan kurtagidayoq yo'q qilish kerak.

words.definitionEn: used to introduce a contrasting point after you have accepted something; works in both Speaking and Writing
words.exampleEn: Online courses are convenient. That being said, they demand real self-discipline.
words.exampleUz: Onlayn kurslar qulay. Shunga qaramay, ular chinakam o'z-o'zini nazorat qilishni talab qiladi.

words.definitionEn: used to give a personal opinion clearly; natural in Speaking Part 3, slightly informal for essays
words.exampleEn: As far as I'm concerned, exams measure memory more than ability.
words.exampleUz: Mening nazarimda, imtihonlar qobiliyatdan ko'ra xotirani o'lchaydi.

words.definitionEn: used to make a general statement while allowing for exceptions; fine in both Speaking and Writing
words.exampleEn: By and large, students who read regularly write better essays.
words.exampleUz: Umuman olganda, muntazam kitob o'qiydigan talabalar yaxshiroq insho yozadi.

words.definitionEn: used to restate an idea more simply or from a different angle; excellent for showing range in Speaking
words.exampleEn: Fees have doubled; to put it another way, half the students can no longer afford them.
words.exampleUz: To'lovlar ikki barobar oshdi; boshqacha aytganda, talabalarning yarmi endi to'lay olmaydi.

words.definitionEn: used at the start of a sentence to admit an opposing point before you argue against it
words.exampleEn: Granted, technology can distract learners, but it also opens up huge resources.
words.exampleUz: To'g'ri, texnologiya o'quvchini chalg'itishi mumkin, lekin u ulkan imkoniyatlarni ham ochadi.

words.definitionEn: used to add a qualification that partly contradicts what you just said; very natural in speech
words.exampleEn: The city is growing fast. Having said that, public transport has not improved.
words.exampleUz: Shahar tez o'smoqda. Shunday bo'lsa ham, jamoat transporti yaxshilanmadi.

words.definitionEn: used to state a conclusion after weighing both sides; ideal for the final paragraph of an essay
words.exampleEn: On balance, the benefits of remote work outweigh its drawbacks.
words.exampleUz: Hammasini hisobga olganda, masofaviy ishning foydasi kamchiliklaridan ustun.

words.definitionEn: used to say something is usually but not always true; a more sophisticated substitute for 'usually'
words.exampleEn: More often than not, the hardest part of the exam is time management.
words.exampleUz: Aksariyat hollarda imtihonning eng qiyin qismi vaqtni boshqarishdir.

words.definitionEn: used before a frank personal opinion; informal, excellent in Speaking Part 1, avoid in Writing
words.exampleEn: To be honest, I never enjoyed studying grammar rules.
words.exampleUz: Rostini aytsam, grammatika qoidalarini o'rganish menga hech yoqmagan.

words.definitionEn: used before something the listener already expects to be true
words.exampleEn: Needless to say, students who practise speaking daily improve fastest.
words.exampleUz: Aytmasa ham ma'lum, har kuni gapirishni mashq qiladigan o'quvchilar eng tez o'sadi.

words.definitionEn: used to give a final judgement after thinking about every aspect; strong closing phrase
words.exampleEn: All things considered, the reform has done more good than harm.
words.exampleUz: Barcha jihatlarni hisobga olsak, islohot zarardan ko'ra ko'proq foyda keltirdi.

words.definitionEn: used to summarise something very briefly; informal to neutral, best in Speaking
words.exampleEn: In a nutshell, the problem is money rather than motivation.
words.exampleUz: Qisqacha aytganda, muammo motivatsiyada emas, pulda.

words.definitionEn: used to say that something is true in most cases; useful for hedging a claim
words.exampleEn: For the most part, employers value experience over certificates.
words.exampleUz: Asosan, ish beruvchilar sertifikatdan ko'ra tajribani qadrlaydi.

words.definitionEn: used to add a second, stronger point in support of your argument
words.exampleEn: The course is free. What's more, it gives you a recognised certificate.
words.exampleUz: Kurs bepul. Qolaversa, u tan olingan sertifikat ham beradi.

words.definitionEn: used to partly agree with a statement without accepting it completely
words.exampleEn: To a certain extent I agree, though the situation is more complex.
words.exampleUz: Ma'lum darajada roziman, garchi vaziyat ancha murakkab bo'lsa-da.

words.definitionEn: used before a clear, short version of a complicated idea
words.exampleEn: Put simply, the more you read, the wider your vocabulary becomes.
words.exampleUz: Oddiy qilib aytganda, qancha ko'p o'qisangiz, so'z boyligingiz shuncha kengayadi.

words.definitionEn: used to describe a general pattern without going into detail
words.exampleEn: Broadly speaking, there are two approaches to learning vocabulary.
words.exampleUz: Keng ma'noda aytganda, so'z o'rganishning ikkita yondashuvi bor.

words.definitionEn: used when you want to be precise and correct a small inaccuracy
words.exampleEn: Strictly speaking, the exam tests four skills, not three.
words.exampleUz: Aniq qilib aytganda, imtihon uchta emas, to'rtta ko'nikmani tekshiradi.

words.definitionEn: used to describe what normally happens
words.exampleEn: As a rule, I revise for an hour before going to bed.
words.exampleUz: Odatda, uxlashdan oldin bir soat takrorlayman.

words.definitionEn: a neutral, formal way of introducing your opinion; safe in academic Writing
words.exampleEn: In my view, practical skills deserve as much attention as theory.
words.exampleUz: Mening fikrimcha, amaliy ko'nikmalar nazariya kabi e'tiborga loyiq.

words.definitionEn: used before an obvious point that everyone would accept
words.exampleEn: It goes without saying that health comes before profit.
words.exampleUz: Salomatlik foydadan ustun ekanini aytishning hojati yo'q.

words.definitionEn: used to give a personal interpretation; informal, natural in Speaking Part 3
words.exampleEn: The way I see it, technology creates as many jobs as it destroys.
words.exampleUz: Mening qarashimcha, texnologiya qancha ish o'rnini yo'q qilsa, shuncha yangisini yaratadi.

words.definitionEn: used when a new idea occurs to you while speaking; informal, sounds very fluent in Speaking
words.exampleEn: Come to think of it, my best English came from watching films, not classes.
words.exampleUz: Endi o'ylab qarasam, ingliz tilimni darslar emas, film ko'rish o'stirgan.

words.definitionEn: used to give a general opinion while allowing for exceptions
words.exampleEn: On the whole, city residents are satisfied with the new metro line.
words.exampleUz: Umuman, shahar aholisi yangi metro liniyasidan mamnun.

words.definitionEn: used to correct or strengthen a statement in the opposite direction to what was expected
words.exampleEn: The rules have not become easier; if anything, they are stricter.
words.exampleUz: Qoidalar yengillashgani yo'q; aksincha, ular qattiqlashdi.

words.definitionEn: used to introduce a thought that weakens what you have just said; informal to neutral, great in Speaking
words.exampleEn: Studying abroad is expensive. Then again, the experience can change your life.
words.exampleUz: Chet elda o'qish qimmat. Boshqa tomondan qaraganda, bu tajriba hayotingizni o'zgartirishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: used to introduce the first of several reasons, usually in speech
words.exampleEn: I would not move to a bigger city. For one thing, the rent is impossible.
words.exampleUz: Kattaroq shaharga ko'chmagan bo'lardim. Birinchidan, ijara narxi ko'tara olmaydigan darajada.

words.definitionEn: used to add an extra point that makes your argument even stronger
words.exampleEn: Cars cause pollution, not to mention the daily stress of traffic jams.
words.exampleUz: Mashinalar havoni ifloslantiradi, buning ustiga kundalik tirbandlik stressi ham bor.

words.definitionEn: used to highlight the single most important point
words.exampleEn: Above all, education should teach young people how to think.
words.exampleUz: Eng muhimi, ta'lim yoshlarga qanday fikrlashni o'rgatishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: used to mention a point in favour of the side you are criticising
words.exampleEn: In fairness, the government has increased the education budget twice.
words.exampleUz: Adolat yuzasidan aytganda, hukumat ta'lim byudjetini ikki marta oshirdi.

words.definitionEn: used to make a strong claim while showing that others might disagree; very useful in academic Writing
words.exampleEn: Arguably, the internet is the most important invention of the last century.
words.exampleUz: Bahsli bo'lsa-da, internet o'tgan asrning eng muhim ixtirosi deyish mumkin.

words.definitionEn: used to signal that the next point is the most decisive one; strong in formal Writing
words.exampleEn: Crucially, the scheme costs the state almost nothing.
words.exampleUz: Eng asosiysi, bu dastur davlatga deyarli hech narsaga tushmaydi.

words.definitionEn: used to say that a second case is similar to the first; formal and concise
words.exampleEn: Reading improves writing; likewise, listening improves pronunciation.
words.exampleUz: Mutolaa yozuvni yaxshilaydi; xuddi shunday, tinglash talaffuzni yaxshilaydi.

words.definitionEn: used to state the most basic truth about something, ignoring details; formal
words.exampleEn: In essence, the argument is about who controls information.
words.exampleUz: Mohiyatan, bahs axborotni kim nazorat qilishi haqida bormoqda.

words.definitionEn: used to show that the same reasoning leads to another conclusion; formal, impressive in essays
words.exampleEn: If we ban adverts for sweets, then by the same token we should ban them for energy drinks.
words.exampleUz: Agar shirinlik reklamasini taqiqlasak, shu mantiqdan kelib chiqib energetik ichimliklarnikini ham taqiqlashimiz kerak.

words.definitionEn: used to reject a previous statement and assert the opposite; formal, do not confuse it with 'in contrast'
words.exampleEn: Learning grammar is not useless; on the contrary, it makes speech far clearer.
words.exampleUz: Grammatika o'rganish foydasiz emas; aksincha, u nutqni ancha aniq qiladi.

words.definitionEn: used to introduce the result of what was just described; formal register
words.exampleEn: Fewer people cook at home and, as a consequence, obesity rates are rising.
words.exampleUz: Kam odam uyda ovqat pishiradi va natijada semizlik ko'rsatkichlari o'smoqda.

words.definitionEn: used to link a recommendation to the reasons you have just given
words.exampleEn: With that in mind, schools should teach digital safety from an early age.
words.exampleUz: Shuni inobatga olib, maktablar raqamli xavfsizlikni erta yoshdan o'rgatishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: used to introduce a short summary at the end of an answer or essay
words.exampleEn: To sum up, the advantages of public transport clearly outweigh the costs.
words.exampleUz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, jamoat transportining afzalliklari xarajatlardan ancha ustun.

words.definitionEn: used to give an overall judgement; slightly less formal than 'to sum up'
words.exampleEn: All in all, my year abroad was the best decision I ever made.
words.exampleUz: Umuman olib qaraganda, chet eldagi bir yilim eng to'g'ri qarorim bo'ldi.

words.definitionEn: used to introduce the most important point in a list
words.exampleEn: First and foremost, a teacher must know how to motivate learners.
words.exampleUz: Avvalambor, o'qituvchi o'quvchini qanday ruhlantirishni bilishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: used to talk about the original reason or starting point of a situation
words.exampleEn: We should ask why the waste was produced in the first place.
words.exampleUz: Avvalo, bu chiqindi umuman nega paydo bo'lganini so'rashimiz kerak.

words.definitionEn: used to introduce an example that proves the point you have just made; formal and precise
words.exampleEn: Some cities have cut traffic dramatically; Amsterdam is a case in point.
words.exampleUz: Ba'zi shaharlar transport oqimini keskin kamaytirdi; Amsterdam aynan shunga misol.

words.definitionEn: used to signal that a concrete example is coming; strengthens Writing Task 2 paragraphs
words.exampleEn: To illustrate the point, my own village got internet only three years ago.
words.exampleUz: Fikrni misol bilan tushuntirsak, mening qishlog'imga internet atigi uch yil oldin keldi.

words.definitionEn: used to refer back to a point you already made, which shows organised thinking
words.exampleEn: As I mentioned earlier, cost is the main barrier for most families.
words.exampleUz: Yuqorida aytganimdek, ko'p oilalar uchun asosiy to'siq bu narx.

words.definitionEn: used to support an opinion with your own life; very natural in Speaking Part 3
words.exampleEn: Speaking from experience, daily short practice beats long weekend sessions.
words.exampleUz: O'z tajribamdan kelib chiqib aytsam, har kungi qisqa mashq uzun dam olish kunidagi mashg'ulotdan afzal.

words.definitionEn: used to add a point that defends the other side; informal to neutral, ideal in Speaking
words.exampleEn: To be fair, most teachers are doing their best with very limited resources.
words.exampleUz: Haqqoniy aytganda, aksariyat o'qituvchilar juda cheklangan imkoniyat bilan qo'lidan kelganini qilmoqda.

words.word: at the end of the day
words.definitionEn: used before your final, most important point; informal, very common in Speaking, avoid in formal Writing
words.exampleEn: At the end of the day, no app can replace real conversation practice.
words.exampleUz: Oxir-oqibat, hech qanday ilova jonli suhbat mashqining o'rnini bosa olmaydi.
